workspace.description: The workspace whose shared memory to act on, by the slug list_workspaces answered; leave it out where the member belongs to one workspace alone.

text.description: The fact or convention, as one self-contained statement a later task can read without this call, such as "The web server's tests run on PGlite through `test:store`."

replaces.description: The id of the memory this one corrects, as search_memory answered it; leave it out for a new memory.
